annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act establishes a harmonised, risk-based legal framework for AI: prohibited practices, obligations for high-risk systems (including AI safety components of regulated products such as machinery, medical devices, vehicles), transparency duties, general-purpose AI model rules, conformity assessment, governance bodies and penalties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibits unacceptable AI practices such as manipulation, social scoring and certain biometric uses
High-risk AI systems must meet requirements on risk management, data governance, documentation, human oversight, accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
AI safety components of products under sectoral harmonisation legislation (machinery, medical devices, vehicles) are high-risk with third-party conformity assessment
Providers must apply CE marking, quality management, registration and post-market monitoring, serious incident reporting
Specific obligations for general-purpose AI models, including systemic-risk models; military use excluded
